The '''autonomic crust-piercer''' was a huge machine used by deep core mining operations for piercing a planet's crust to get at the ore. [[Trhin Voss'on't]] turned on this machine as a last attempt to escape from [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], who were after him. Bossk was caught on top of its pole and after the machine emerged from the ground still running, it tilted and fell down almost killing both [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
